color.$description: Semantic colors for the light theme. Components reference these by role (ink, surface, accent and so on) rather than by raw palette value, so the same component renders correctly in every theme.

emphasis.$description: Neutral, high-contrast accent used by the default `base` theme. Use it for primary controls and emphasized content that should not carry a brand or status color. Most components read it as `accent`, for example Button fills, the Switch thumb, Checkbox marks, LabelText, Spinner and Progress indicators.

ink.$description: Default text and icon color for running copy and standard content. Used by BodyText and body content in Card, Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, Accordion, CodeBlock, DataTable, TypeTable and Stepper.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis neutral color for the `base` theme, a softer alternative to the full accent. Exposed as `muted`; used for `subtle` Button fills, Badge hover, Switch tracks, Footer and `secondary` Container backgrounds, FileTree row hover and selected DataTable rows.

subtlest.$description: Low-emphasis neutral color for the `base` theme, a softer alternative to the full accent. Exposed as `muted`; used for `subtle` Button fills, Badge hover, Switch tracks, Footer and `secondary` Container backgrounds, FileTree row hover and selected DataTable rows.

outline.$description: High-contrast color for borders, dividers and separators. Use it to outline controls and split content without adding visual weight. Default color of Divider, and the border color for Input, TextArea, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Switch, Accordion, Table, Tabs and Footer, and the Sheet drag handle.

hairline.$description: Low-contrast color for borders, dividers and separators.

sunken.$description: Recessed surface that sits below the page canvas. Use it for tracks, wells and inset areas that hold other content. Used for the Progress and CircularProgress tracks, the Tabs list background, ScrollView scrollbar tracks and the `sunken` Container variant.

canvas.$description: Base page background that everything else sits on. Use it for full-page backgrounds and large flush regions. Used by NavigationHeader, the `canvas` Container variant, Tabs panels, CodeBlock bodies, Table row hover and GlitchSeparator.

surface.$description: Raised surface one step above the canvas, for resting cards and controls. This is the default background for interactive elements and the gap color inside offset focus rings. Used by Button (`surface` variant), Input, TextArea, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Card, Accordion, Table, Tabs and FileTree.

elevated.$description: Surface for content that floats above the page, such as menus, popovers and dialogs. Used by Popover, Tooltip, the Select dropdown, AlertDialog, Sheet, SearchInput results, active CodeBlock tabs and the `floating` Container variant.

floating.$description: Topmost surface, for transient content layered over floating surfaces and for small highlighted chips. Used by Alert and its icon background, InlineCodeText, hovered Select items and the `overlay` Container variant.

base.$description: Base theme colors used as the default throughout the project.

primary.$description: Neutral, high-contrast accent used by the default `base` theme. Use it for primary controls and emphasized content that should not carry a brand or status color. Most components read it as `accent`, for example Button fills, the Switch thumb, Checkbox marks, LabelText, Spinner and Progress indicators.

secondary.$description: Default text and icon color for running copy and standard content. Used by BodyText and body content in Card, Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet, Accordion, CodeBlock, DataTable, TypeTable and Stepper.

link.$description: The color used for hyperlink text.

brand.$description: A theme representing the core brand colors.

primary.$description: The Storm Teal color is used as the primary brand color for Storm Software.

danger.$description: Danger theme colors used for destructive actions and error states.

primary.$description: Danger accent used by the `danger` theme. Use it for destructive actions, such as delete buttons, and for error states. Applied by Alert `danger` and `error` Messages and ValidationText.

warning.$description: Warning theme colors used for cautionary states that need attention but do not block the user.

primary.$description: Warning accent used by the `warning` theme. Use it for cautionary states that need attention but do not block the user. Applied by Alert `warning` and `warning` Messages and ValidationText.

info.$description: Info theme colors used for neutral guidance, tips and system notices.

primary.$description: Info accent used by the `info` theme. Use it for neutral guidance, tips and system notices. Applied by Alert `info` and `info` Messages and ValidationText.

secondary.$description: Secondary info color used by the `info` theme. Use it for less prominent info elements. Applied by Alert `info` and `info` Messages and ValidationText.

discovery.$description: Discovery theme colors used for highlighting new features, onboarding, and help content.

primary.$description: Discovery accent used by the `discovery` theme. Use it to highlight new features, onboarding and help content. Applied by `help` Messages.

secondary.$description: Low-emphasis discovery color for the `discovery` theme. Exposed as `muted` inside that theme; use it for soft discovery-tinted fills, such as a `subtle` Button or the decorative Callout icon and gradient in the discovery theme.

success.$description: Success theme colors used for confirming actions and valid states.

primary.$description: Success accent used by the `success` theme. Use it to confirm that an action completed or a value is valid. Applied by Alert `success` and `success` Messages and ValidationText.

backdrop.$description: Semi-transparent color that dims the page behind modal content and softens floating shadows. Used as the backdrop of Dialog and Sheet, and as the shadow color for Popover, Tooltip, the Select dropdown and the `floating` Container.

shadow.$description: Box-shadow presets for elevation. Resting shadows lift elements slightly off their surface; floating shadows separate content that sits above the page.

xsmall.$description: Smallest resting shadow (`shadow.2xs`): a single 1px edge under the element. Use it to give flat controls, such as inputs and segmented buttons, a hint of depth.

small.$description: Small resting shadow (`shadow.xs`). Use it for cards, tiles and buttons sitting directly on the canvas.

medium.$description: Medium resting shadow (`shadow.sm`). Use it for raised cards and panels that need more separation from the canvas than `resting.small`.

small.$description: Small floating shadow (`shadow.md`). Use it for compact floating content, such as tooltips and dropdown menus.

medium.$description: Medium floating shadow (`shadow.lg`). Use it for popovers, menus and other anchored panels.

large.$description: Large floating shadow (`shadow.xl`). Use it for dialogs, drawers and sheets that sit above the whole page.

xlarge.$description: Largest floating shadow (`shadow.2xl`). Use it for the highest-elevation content, such as full-screen modals or command palettes.

inset.$description: Inset shadow (`inset-shadow.xs`) for recessed elements. Use it for wells and pressed states that should read as sunken into their surface.

data.$description: Categorical colors for charts and data visualizations. Each hue has an `emphasis` value for the primary mark (line, bar, point) and a `subtle` value for fills, areas, ranges and backgrounds. Prefer these over accent colors so status meaning stays separate from data series.

emphasis.$description: High-emphasis neutral (gray) data color. Use it for the primary mark of a neutral series, such as lines, bars, points and legend swatches. Suits baselines, totals and comparison series that should not compete with colored data.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis neutral (gray) data color. Use it for area fills, ranges, bar backgrounds and hover highlights behind the `neutral.emphasis` series.

emphasis.$description: High-emphasis red data color. Use it for the primary mark of a red series, such as lines, bars, points and legend swatches.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis red data color. Use it for area fills, ranges, bar backgrounds and hover highlights behind the `red.emphasis` series.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis orange data color. Use it for area fills, ranges, bar backgrounds and hover highlights behind the `orange.emphasis` series.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis yellow data color. Use it for area fills, ranges, bar backgrounds and hover highlights behind the `yellow.emphasis` series.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis green data color. Use it for area fills, ranges, bar backgrounds and hover highlights behind the `green.emphasis` series.

emphasis.$description: High-emphasis blue data color. Use it for the primary mark of a blue series, such as lines, bars, points and legend swatches.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis blue data color. Use it for area fills, ranges, bar backgrounds and hover highlights behind the `blue.emphasis` series.

emphasis.$description: High-emphasis purple data color. Use it for the primary mark of a purple series, such as lines, bars, points and legend swatches.

subtle.$description: Low-emphasis purple data color. Use it for area fills, ranges, bar backgrounds and hover highlights behind the `purple.emphasis` series.

emphasis.$description: High-emphasis pink data color. Use it for the primary mark of a pink series, such as lines, bars, points and legend swatches.
